title: Beginning of the Christian era
summary: Jones dates the beginning of the Christian era at AM 4004, which he prints as 1 AD.
description: Jones dates the beginning of the Christian era at AM 4004, which he prints as 1 AD. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.
